## ConnectionService.processRequest() method

Process a received connection request message. This will not accept the connection request or send a connection response message. It will only update the existing connection record with all the new information from the connection request message. Use [ConnectionService.createResponse()](./core.connectionservice.createresponse.md) after calling this function to create a connection response.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
processRequest(messageContext: InboundMessageContext<ConnectionRequestMessage>, routing?: Routing): Promise<ConnectionRecord>;
```

| -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| messageContext | [InboundMessageContext](./core.inboundmessagecontext.md)&lt;[ConnectionRequestMessage](./core.connectionrequestmessage.md)&gt; | the message context containing a connection request message |
| routing        | [Routing](./core.routing.md)                                                                                                   | <i>(Optional)</i>                                           |
